731:t_007:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Thanks to you, the $$スフィア$$s within me are becoming more active.」

731:t_007:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You understand now, don't you? Your power cannot kill me.」

731:t_007:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is cheap provocation. Do you think that will unsettle us?」

731:t_007:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then silence me with your strength rather than your words.」

731:t_007:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh... I look forward to it.」

731:t_008:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Not yet...! It still isn't enough!」

731:t_009:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it! He healed the damage again!」

731:t_009:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「His regenerative ability...! It's beyond that of any $$スフィア・リアクター$$ we've fought!」

731:t_009:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So this is his power of immortality.」

731:t_009:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I do not understand how it works.」

731:t_009:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「But one thing is certain: he himself does not want eternity.」

731:t_009:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to understand me a little.」

731:t_009:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Misery loves company, as they say. But I am better off than you, since I at least know a way I can die.」

731:t_009:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh heh... I envy you.」

731:t_009:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What do we do now?! At this rate, this'll never end!」

731:t_009:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Eventually, we will run out of strength...」

731:t_009:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「Nothing in this world is absolute or infinite! If we keep hitting it, it'll break someday!」

731:t_009:12.en:
$$メール$$
「That's right! If that weren't true, repairers would all be out of a job!」

731:t_009:13.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I do not dislike that fiery spirit...」

731:t_009:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then stop fighting! I'll teach you what liquor tastes like for real this time!」

731:t_009:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll just have to keep hitting him...! It's a test of endurance: does his infinity run out first, or do we collapse first?!」

731:t_009:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do it! Third time's the charm!」

731:t_009:19.en:
$$桂$$
「Please don't let this turn into 'things happen in threes'!」

731:t_009:20.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now, come. Can you surpass infinity?」

731:t_010:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Damage to $$アサキム$$'s unit has exceeded fifty percent!」

731:t_010:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Good...! His regenerative ability isn't activating!」

731:t_010:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems he has run out of magic tricks!」

731:t_010:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Then all we have to do is keep pushing!」

731:t_010:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And even if you break $$シュロウガ・シン$$'s wings...」

731:t_010:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Stop, $$アサキム$$! You'll just have to look forward to what comes after that!」

731:t_010:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We will simply concentrate on stopping you!」

731:t_010:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Very well! Then our true battle begins now!」

731:t_011:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Are you watching, $$サクリファイ$$?! This is life... what you have lost!」

731:t_011:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Battle is the clash of those lives! Yes... Life itself gives birth to the future!」

731:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That bastard still had strength left!」

731:t_011:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Bring it on! We can't call this a final showdown unless we both give everything we've got!」

731:t_011:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll surpass that! And we'll seize victory!」

731:t_011:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I will soar above you! On these black wings of sin that transcend causality!」

731:t_011:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come, $$シュロウガ・シン$$! Let us show them the end of a great kalpa!」

731:t_012:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「Here we go, $$エスター$$! $$Ｚクリスタル$$, full drive!」

731:t_012:3.en:
$$エスター$$
「Understood! D-Energy synchronization is good!」

731:t_012:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm activating the dimensional barrier system!」

731:t_014:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You should understand, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$. My power is increasing even at this very moment.」

731:t_014:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is it because you became a $$リアクター$$ yourself, rather than merely using four $$スフィア$$s as devices to extract $$次元力|lc$$...?」

731:t_014:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$ is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$... And he's drawing out the individual powers of all four $$スフィア$$s...?!」

731:t_014:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「He did use the $$知りたがる山羊$$'s power when he defeated $$アイム#pilot$$, but...」

731:t_014:6.en:
$n
「That's impossible! Even $$ヴィルダーク$$ couldn't use powers other than his own $$スフィア$$, the $$立ち上がる射手$$!」

731:t_014:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You and I differ at the very root of our existence. That is why I could do it.」

731:t_015:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Within $$火星$$' $$ＺＯＮＥ$$, I kept wondering... Who am I...?」

731:t_015:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The answer was that I, too, am human... Or at least, I wish to live as a human.」

731:t_015:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That gave me the means to draw out the $$スフィア$$s' power.」

731:t_015:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The $$知りたがる山羊$$... I desired all knowledge in the universe and touched the $$アカシックレコード$$...」

731:t_015:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The $$夢見る双魚$$... And I dreamed of the day my wish would finally come true...」

731:t_015:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The $$偽りの黒羊$$... To that end, I hid my true feelings and once joined forces with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

731:t_015:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$... I loved you.」

731:t_015:9.en:
$$アサキム$$
「No... To be precise, it was not me. Something that created me loved your existence.」

731:t_015:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You burn your finite lives and live with all your might... Your fighting spirit that bows to no one is infinite freedom...」

731:t_015:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It is precious... and worthy of love.」

731:t_015:13.en:
$n
「But if you are a $$リアクター$$ for four people, we have a way!」

731:t_016:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$! Have you come to be hunted by me of your own accord?!」

731:t_016:1.en:
$n
「Drawing out the power of multiple $$スフィア$$s will be your downfall!」

731:t_017:1.en:
$n
「By drawing out the power of multiple $$スフィア$$s, you came closer to $$至高神ソル$$'s original form...」

kept_omissions: 731:t_009:3: Zero calls C.C. by name to seek insight into Asakim's immortality; she answers in 731:t_009:4.
731:t_009:16: Setsuko addresses Asakim emotionally after he refuses Rand's invitation to stop fighting.
731:t_009:21: Sacrifice privately calls Asakim by name while watching the battle.
731:t_010:5: Asakim leaves the hypothetical about breaking Shurouga Sin's wings unfinished; Rand cuts him off in 731:t_010:6.
731:t_011:1: Sacrifice's punctuation-only reaction responds to Asakim's statement about life.
731:t_012:0: Asakim's 'Tch' is a short frustrated vocal reaction after being stopped.
731:t_013:0: Asakim's isolated exclamation mark is his nonverbal reaction to the activated barrier.
731:t_014:5: Crowe confirms the Truth-Seeking Goat precedent but trails off at 'but'; Hibiki states the apparent impossibility in 731:t_014:6.
731:t_015:8: Setsuko's punctuation-only reaction responds to Asakim saying he loved them.
731:t_015:12: Rand starts 'You' without completing his thought after Asakim describes the creator's love.
731:t_017:0: Asakim starts 'This is' and stops on experiencing Hibiki's attack; Hibiki explains the principle in 731:t_017:1-2.
uncertain: 731:t_011:7: 'The end of a great kalpa' preserves the Buddhist cosmic-time phrase in Asakim's attack invitation; parent research confirmed the contextual rendering.
